key.name: topbar-blur-enabled
key.description: Whether the top bar (panel) has a blurred background.

key.name: topbar-tint-mode
key.description: Color overlay on the blurred top bar (none, dark, light, black).

key.name: topbar-tint-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the tint color overlay.

key.name: topbar-blur-mode
key.description: Dynamic blurs whatever is behind the bar, including windows. Static only blurs the wallpaper once and is much cheaper.

key.name: topbar-smart-mode
key.description: Whether to disable blur when a window is maximized or touches the top bar.

key.name: topbar-unblur-in-overview
key.description: Whether to disable blur when opening the overview.

key.name: topbar-corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius for rounded or floating top bars in pixels.

key.name: overview-blur-enabled
key.description: Whether the desktop wallpaper is blurred during the overview.

key.name: overview-blur-radius
key.description: Blur radius / strength in pixels for the overview background.

key.name: overview-blur-brightness
key.description: Brightness percentage for the blurred overview background (10% to 100%).

key.name: overview-tint-mode
key.description: Color overlay on the blurred overview background (none, dark, light, black).

key.name: overview-tint-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the tint color overlay.

key.name: overview-corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels of the workspace previews in the overview. GNOME's default is 30.

key.name: overview-components-style
key.description: Restyle the search entry, dash and workspace thumbnails so they blend with the blur (default, dark, transparent).
